name: Sloppy Joe Squares
description: A layered casserole featuring a sloppy joe beef mixture between two layers of crescent roll dough, topped with mozzarella cheese and baked until golden brown.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the beef, onions, and spices in a skillet over medium heat until the meat is no longer red.
Blend in flour to thicken the mixture.
Add 1¼ cups water, ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9×13 inch pan with 1 package of crescent rolls.
Spread the beef mixture evenly over the layer of rolls.
Top the beef mixture with mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the second package of crescent dinner rolls, ensuring the dough touches the edges of the pan.
Bake at 350°F until the crescent rolls are browned.
Serve with a salad.

keywords: sloppy joe, casserole, crescent rolls, beef

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Taco Ring
_similar.description: A savory taco-flavored ring made with crescent rolls, ground beef, and cheese, served with salsa and fresh toppings.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry the hamburger and let it cool.
Add ¼ cup water and taco seasoning mix to the fried hamburger.
Lay the crescent roll dough on the outside edge of a 15-inch pizza-style pan, forming a circle with the pointed edge out.
Scoop the hamburger mixture onto the dough, leaving a 5-inch wide circle in the center.
Add shredded cheese on top of the hamburger mixture.
Bring the pointed edge of the pastry over the beef mixture and press to seal.
Bake for approximately 16 minutes or as per the directions on the pastry package until golden brown.
Let cool slightly before serving.
To serve, remove the top from the green pepper and scoop out the insides. Place salsa inside the green pepper.
Place the green pepper in the middle of the ring along with shredded lettuce and tomato. Serve with sour cream.

_similar.keywords: taco ring, crescent roll recipe, taco bake, Mexican-inspired

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple and customizable veggie pizza using crescent rolls as the crust, topped with a cream cheese mixture and various vegetables.
recipeIngredient: Veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery, red or green peppers, green onions)

recipeInstructions.text: Roll out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and a small cake pan. Bake until golden brown. Cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and ranch dressing to make the cream mixture.
Spread cream mixture on cooled rolls.
Top with finely chopped vegetables of your choice.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Chill and cut into small pieces. Serve as hors d'oeuvres.
